en-US.Population {pop} in {days} days. Unranke: Population {pop} in {days} days. Unranked, undo enabled.
en-US.Welcome back — your settlement is exactl: Welcome back — your settlement is exactly as you left it.
en-US.Saved game could not be loaded (version: Saved game could not be loaded (version mismatch).
en-US.Nothing useful to do — wait for the next: Nothing useful to do — wait for the next day.
en-US.💡 You can fulfil a trade order from the: 💡 You can fulfil a trade order from the orders panel.
en-US.Platform leaderboard — read only. Local: Platform leaderboard — read only. Local scores keep your full history.
en-US.No friends yet — showing your own scores: No friends yet — showing your own scores.
A resident left an unhappy home.
en-US.Food shortage! Residents are going hungr: Food shortage! Residents are going hungry.
en-US.The charter expired before objectives we: The charter expired before objectives were met.
en-US.No open orders. New orders arrive every: No open orders. New orders arrive every few days.
en-US.Every objective complete — the settlemen: Every objective complete — the settlement thrives.
en-US.The charter ran out of days before objec: The charter ran out of days before objectives were met.
en-US.No scores yet — be the first!: No scores yet — be the first!
en-US.Grow your settlement to meet the charter: Grow your settlement to meet the charter objectives before the final day. Residents move into **happy** homes and leave unhappy ones.
en-US.A happy home has three things: a **road*: A happy home has three things: a **road** connected to the Village Hall, **water** from a Well within 2 tiles, and **food** in the town stockpile. A nearby Market adds comfort and tax income.
en-US.Every few days a trade order arrives: de: Every few days a trade order arrives: deliver the requested goods before it expires to earn coins. Coins fund expansion.
Pointer/touch: pick a tool, tap a tile. Drag pans the map, scroll zooms.
en-US.Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, [[{con: Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, [[{confirm}]] build/inspect, [[{cancel}]] cancel or pause, [[{undo}]] undo, [[{hint}]] hint, [[{speed}]] change speed, [[{camera}]] reset camera, [[1–7]] tools.
en-US.Gamepad: stick/d-pad moves the cursor, A: Gamepad: stick/d-pad moves the cursor, A confirms, B cancels, Start pauses.
en-US.A cozy low-poly settlement builder spann: A cozy low-poly settlement builder spanning river and hills.
en-US.Lay roads and raise houses. Connect ever: Lay roads and raise houses. Connect every home to the hall.
en-US.Wells supply water within 2 tiles. Keep: Wells supply water within 2 tiles. Keep every home watered.
en-US.Farms grow food on grass; riverside farm: Farms grow food on grass; riverside farms yield more.
en-US.Lumber huts must border forest. Wood fue: Lumber huts must border forest. Wood fuels expansion.
en-US.Markets serve homes within 3 tiles and f: Markets serve homes within 3 tiles and fulfil trade orders.
Prove your mastery under tighter limits.
en-US.Select the Road tool, then build a road: Select the Road tool, then build a road next to the Village Hall.
Build one more road extending outward.
en-US.Select the House tool and build a house: Select the House tool and build a house beside a connected road.
en-US.Build a second house. Residents move in: Build a second house. Residents move in when homes are happy.
en-US.Reach 4 residents before the charter exp: Reach 4 residents before the charter expires. Time passes on its own — use pause if you need to think.
en-US.Homes need water. Build two houses near: Homes need water. Build two houses near the hall first.
en-US.Build a Well within 2 tiles of your hous: Build a Well within 2 tiles of your houses.
en-US.Grow to 6 residents. Watch each home’s n: Grow to 6 residents. Watch each home’s needs icons.
en-US.Hungry residents leave. Build a Farm on: Hungry residents leave. Build a Farm on grass — riverside farms yield +1 food.
Build a Well to cover your homes.
en-US.Reach 8 residents without a food shortag: Reach 8 residents without a food shortage.
en-US.Wood runs out fast. Build a Lumber Hut b: Wood runs out fast. Build a Lumber Hut bordering a forest tile.
en-US.Build a Market on a connected road. It s: Build a Market on a connected road. It serves homes within 3 tiles.
en-US.Trade orders arrive every few days. Fulf: Trade orders arrive every few days. Fulfil one from the orders panel when you have the goods.
A very short charter. Every day counts.
en-US.Only 10 road tiles may exist at once. Pl: Only 10 road tiles may exist at once. Plan the network carefully.
en-US.Rock-strewn land leaves little room to b: Rock-strewn land leaves little room to build.
en-US.One shared map for everyone today. Same: One shared map for everyone today. Same seed, same rules.
en-US.The heart of the settlement. Roads must: The heart of the settlement. Roads must connect back to it.
Connects buildings to the village hall. Cuts through forest.
en-US.Houses up to 4 residents. Needs road, wa: Houses up to 4 residents. Needs road, water and food. Clears forest.
en-US.Produces 4 food per day, +1 beside water: Produces 4 food per day, +1 beside water.
en-US.Produces wood each day. Must border fore: Produces wood each day. Must border forest.
Supplies water to houses within 2 tiles. Clears forest.
en-US.Serves homes within 3 tiles, raising hap: Serves homes within 3 tiles, raising happiness and taxes. Clears forest.
en-US.That building is not available in this s: That building is not available in this scenario.
en-US.This building cannot be placed on that t: This building cannot be placed on that terrain.
Only one Village Hall can exist.
Lumber Huts must border a forest tile.
en-US.Must touch a road connected to the Villa: Must touch a road connected to the Village Hall.
The Village Hall cannot be demolished.
There is nothing to demolish here.
That trade order is no longer available.
You lack the goods this order requires.
en-US.This scenario limits how many roads may: This scenario limits how many roads may exist at once.
Undo is not available in this mode.
en-US.Progress restored from your StarHermit c: Progress restored from your StarHermit cloud save.
en-US.Volumes, mute, graphics quality, languag: Volumes, mute, graphics quality, language, larger text, high contrast and reduced motion are in the StarHermit Options.

es-419.Population {pop} in {days} days. Unranke: Población {pop} en {days} días. Sin clasificar, se puede deshacer.
es-419.Welcome back — your settlement is exactl: Bienvenido de nuevo: tu asentamiento está tal como lo dejaste.
es-419.Saved game could not be loaded (version: No se pudo cargar la partida guardada (versión incompatible).
es-419.Nothing useful to do — wait for the next: No hay nada útil que hacer: espera al día siguiente.
es-419.💡 You can fulfil a trade order from the: 💡 Puedes cumplir un pedido comercial desde el panel de pedidos.
es-419.Platform leaderboard — read only. Local: Clasificación de la plataforma: solo lectura. Las puntuaciones locales guardan todo tu historial.
es-419.No friends yet — showing your own scores: Aún no tienes amigos: se muestran tus propias puntuaciones.
Un residente dejó un hogar infeliz.
es-419.New trade order: {n} {res} for {reward}: Nuevo pedido comercial: {n} de {res} por {reward} monedas.
es-419.Day {day}: +{food} food, +{wood} wood, +: Día {day}: +{food} de comida, +{wood} de madera, +{coins} monedas de impuestos.
es-419.Food shortage! Residents are going hungr: ¡Escasez de comida! Los residentes pasan hambre.
es-419.The charter expired before objectives we: La carta venció antes de cumplir los objetivos.
es-419.No open orders. New orders arrive every: No hay pedidos abiertos. Llegan nuevos cada pocos días.
Selecciona una casilla o un edificio.
es-419.Every objective complete — the settlemen: Todos los objetivos cumplidos: el asentamiento prospera.
es-419.The charter ran out of days before objec: La carta se quedó sin días antes de cumplir los objetivos.
es-419.No scores yet — be the first!: Aún no hay puntuaciones: ¡sé el primero!
es-419.Grow your settlement to meet the charter: Haz crecer tu asentamiento para cumplir los objetivos de la carta antes del último día. Los residentes se mudan a hogares **felices** y dejan los infelices.
es-419.A happy home has three things: a **road*: Un hogar feliz tiene tres cosas: un **camino** conectado al Ayuntamiento, **agua** de un Pozo a 2 casillas como máximo y **comida** en la despensa del pueblo. Un Mercado cercano añade comodidad e impuestos.
es-419.Every few days a trade order arrives: de: Cada pocos días llega un pedido comercial: entrega los bienes pedidos antes de que venza para ganar monedas. Las monedas financian la expansión.
Puntero/táctil: elige una herramienta y toca una casilla. Arrastrar mueve el mapa; la rueda hace zoom.
es-419.Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, [[{con: Teclado: las flechas mueven el cursor, [[{confirm}]] construir/inspeccionar, [[{cancel}]] cancelar o pausar, [[{undo}]] deshacer, [[{hint}]] pista, [[{speed}]] cambiar velocidad, [[{camera}]] restablecer cámara, [[1–7]] herramientas.
es-419.Gamepad: stick/d-pad moves the cursor, A: Mando: el stick o la cruceta mueven el cursor, A confirma, B cancela, Start pausa.
es-419.A cozy low-poly settlement builder spann: Un acogedor constructor de asentamientos low-poly entre ríos y colinas.
es-419.Lay roads and raise houses. Connect ever: Traza caminos y levanta casas. Conecta cada hogar al ayuntamiento.
es-419.Wells supply water within 2 tiles. Keep: Los pozos dan agua en un radio de 2 casillas. Que no falte agua en ningún hogar.
es-419.Farms grow food on grass; riverside farm: Las granjas producen comida sobre hierba; las de la ribera rinden más.
es-419.Lumber huts must border forest. Wood fue: Las cabañas de leñador deben estar junto al bosque. La madera impulsa la expansión.
es-419.Markets serve homes within 3 tiles and f: Los mercados sirven a los hogares a 3 casillas y cumplen pedidos comerciales.
Demuestra tu maestría con límites más estrictos.
es-419.Select the Road tool, then build a road: Elige la herramienta Camino y construye un camino junto al Ayuntamiento.
Construye un camino más hacia afuera.
es-419.Select the House tool and build a house: Elige la herramienta Casa y construye una casa junto a un camino conectado.
es-419.Build a second house. Residents move in: Construye una segunda casa. Los residentes se mudan cuando los hogares son felices.
es-419.Reach 4 residents before the charter exp: Llega a 4 residentes antes de que venza la carta. El tiempo avanza solo: pausa si necesitas pensar.
es-419.Homes need water. Build two houses near: Los hogares necesitan agua. Primero construye dos casas cerca del ayuntamiento.
es-419.Build a Well within 2 tiles of your hous: Construye un Pozo a 2 casillas como máximo de tus casas.
es-419.Grow to 6 residents. Watch each home’s n: Llega a 6 residentes. Fíjate en los iconos de necesidades de cada hogar.
es-419.Hungry residents leave. Build a Farm on: Los residentes con hambre se van. Construye una Granja sobre hierba: las de la ribera dan +1 de comida.
Construye un Pozo que cubra tus hogares.
es-419.Reach 8 residents without a food shortag: Llega a 8 residentes sin escasez de comida.
es-419.Wood runs out fast. Build a Lumber Hut b: La madera se acaba rápido. Construye una Cabaña de leñador junto a una casilla de bosque.
Sostén el crecimiento: llega a 8 residentes.
es-419.Build a Market on a connected road. It s: Construye un Mercado junto a un camino conectado. Sirve a los hogares a 3 casillas.
es-419.Trade orders arrive every few days. Fulf: Cada pocos días llegan pedidos comerciales. Cumple uno desde el panel de pedidos cuando tengas los bienes.
Una carta muy corta. Cada día cuenta.
es-419.Only 10 road tiles may exist at once. Pl: Solo puede haber 10 casillas de camino a la vez. Planifica bien la red.
El comercio lo es todo: cumple 4 pedidos.
es-419.Rock-strewn land leaves little room to b: La tierra llena de rocas deja poco espacio para construir.
es-419.One shared map for everyone today. Same: Un mapa compartido para todos hoy. Misma semilla, mismas reglas.
es-419.Unranked. Undo allowed. Experiment freel: Sin clasificar. Se puede deshacer. Experimenta libremente.
es-419.The heart of the settlement. Roads must: El corazón del asentamiento. Los caminos deben conectarse con él.
Conecta los edificios con el ayuntamiento. Atraviesa el bosque.
es-419.Houses up to 4 residents. Needs road, wa: Aloja hasta 4 residentes. Necesita camino, agua y comida. Despeja el bosque.
es-419.Produces 4 food per day, +1 beside water: Produce 4 de comida al día, +1 junto al agua.
es-419.Produces wood each day. Must border fore: Produce madera cada día. Debe estar junto al bosque.
Da agua a las casas a 2 casillas. Despeja el bosque.
es-419.Serves homes within 3 tiles, raising hap: Sirve a los hogares a 3 casillas y aumenta la felicidad y los impuestos. Despeja el bosque.
es-419.That building is not available in this s: Ese edificio no está disponible en este escenario.
es-419.This building cannot be placed on that t: Este edificio no se puede colocar en ese terreno.
Las cabañas de leñador deben estar junto a una casilla de bosque.
es-419.Must touch a road connected to the Villa: Debe tocar un camino conectado al Ayuntamiento.
El Ayuntamiento no se puede demoler.
Aquí no hay nada que demoler.
Ese pedido comercial ya no está disponible.
No tienes los bienes que requiere este pedido.
es-419.This scenario limits how many roads may: Este escenario limita cuántos caminos puede haber a la vez.
Deshacer no está disponible en este modo.
es-419.Progress restored from your StarHermit c: Progreso restaurado desde tu guardado en la nube de StarHermit.
es-419.Volumes, mute, graphics quality, languag: El volumen, el silencio, la calidad gráfica, el idioma, el texto grande, el alto contraste y el movimiento reducido están en las Opciones de StarHermit.

de-DE.Population {pop} in {days} days. Unranke: Bevölkerung {pop} in {days} Tagen. Ungewertet, Rückgängig möglich.
de-DE.Welcome back — your settlement is exactl: Willkommen zurück – deine Siedlung ist genau so, wie du sie verlassen hast.
de-DE.Nothing useful to do — wait for the next: Gerade nichts Sinnvolles zu tun – warte auf den nächsten Tag.
de-DE.💡 You can fulfil a trade order from the: 💡 Du kannst einen Handelsauftrag im Auftragsbereich erfüllen.
de-DE.Platform leaderboard — read only. Local: Plattform-Bestenliste – nur lesbar. Lokale Punktzahlen behalten deinen gesamten Verlauf.
de-DE.No friends yet — showing your own scores: Noch keine Freunde – deine eigenen Punktzahlen werden gezeigt.
Ein Bewohner hat ein unglückliches Zuhause verlassen.
de-DE.The charter expired before objectives we: Die Charta ist abgelaufen, bevor die Ziele erreicht waren.
de-DE.No open orders. New orders arrive every: Keine offenen Aufträge. Alle paar Tage kommen neue.
de-DE.Every objective complete — the settlemen: Alle Ziele erreicht – die Siedlung blüht.
de-DE.The charter ran out of days before objec: Die Tage der Charta sind abgelaufen, bevor die Ziele erreicht waren.
de-DE.No scores yet — be the first!: Noch keine Punktzahlen – sei die oder der Erste!
de-DE.Grow your settlement to meet the charter: Lass deine Siedlung wachsen, bis die Ziele der Charta vor dem letzten Tag erfüllt sind. Bewohner ziehen in **glückliche** Häuser und verlassen unglückliche.
de-DE.A happy home has three things: a **road*: Ein glückliches Zuhause hat drei Dinge: eine **Straße** mit Verbindung zum Dorfhaus, **Wasser** von einem Brunnen in höchstens 2 Feldern Entfernung und **Nahrung** im Vorrat der Stadt. Ein Markt in der Nähe bringt Komfort und Steuereinnahmen.
de-DE.Every few days a trade order arrives: de: Alle paar Tage kommt ein Handelsauftrag: Liefere die gewünschten Waren, bevor er abläuft, und verdiene Münzen. Münzen finanzieren den Ausbau.
Zeiger/Touch: Werkzeug wählen, auf ein Feld tippen. Ziehen verschiebt die Karte, Scrollen zoomt.
de-DE.Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, [[{con: Tastatur: Pfeiltasten bewegen den Cursor, [[{confirm}]] bauen/ansehen, [[{cancel}]] abbrechen oder pausieren, [[{undo}]] rückgängig, [[{hint}]] Tipp, [[{speed}]] Tempo ändern, [[{camera}]] Kamera zurücksetzen, [[1–7]] Werkzeuge.
de-DE.Gamepad: stick/d-pad moves the cursor, A: Gamepad: Stick/Steuerkreuz bewegt den Cursor, A bestätigt, B bricht ab, Start pausiert.
de-DE.A cozy low-poly settlement builder spann: Ein gemütliches Low-Poly-Siedlungsspiel zwischen Fluss und Hügeln.
de-DE.Lay roads and raise houses. Connect ever: Lege Straßen an und baue Häuser. Verbinde jedes Haus mit dem Dorfhaus.
de-DE.Wells supply water within 2 tiles. Keep: Brunnen versorgen alles in 2 Feldern Umkreis mit Wasser. Halte jedes Haus versorgt.
de-DE.Farms grow food on grass; riverside farm: Höfe bauen auf Gras Nahrung an; Höfe am Fluss bringen mehr.
de-DE.Lumber huts must border forest. Wood fue: Holzfällerhütten müssen an Wald grenzen. Holz treibt den Ausbau an.
de-DE.Markets serve homes within 3 tiles and f: Märkte versorgen Häuser in 3 Feldern Umkreis und erfüllen Handelsaufträge.
Beweise dein Können unter strengeren Vorgaben.
de-DE.Select the Road tool, then build a road: Wähle das Straßenwerkzeug und baue eine Straße neben dem Dorfhaus.
Baue noch eine Straße, die nach außen führt.
de-DE.Select the House tool and build a house: Wähle das Hauswerkzeug und baue ein Haus neben einer verbundenen Straße.
de-DE.Build a second house. Residents move in: Baue ein zweites Haus. Bewohner ziehen ein, wenn die Häuser glücklich sind.
de-DE.Reach 4 residents before the charter exp: Erreiche 4 Bewohner, bevor die Charta abläuft. Die Zeit läuft von selbst – pausiere, wenn du nachdenken musst.
de-DE.Homes need water. Build two houses near: Häuser brauchen Wasser. Baue zuerst zwei Häuser nahe dem Dorfhaus.
de-DE.Build a Well within 2 tiles of your hous: Baue einen Brunnen höchstens 2 Felder von deinen Häusern entfernt.
de-DE.Grow to 6 residents. Watch each home’s n: Wachse auf 6 Bewohner. Achte auf die Bedarfssymbole jedes Hauses.
de-DE.Hungry residents leave. Build a Farm on: Hungrige Bewohner ziehen weg. Baue einen Hof auf Gras – Höfe am Fluss bringen +1 Nahrung.
Baue einen Brunnen, der deine Häuser versorgt.
de-DE.Wood runs out fast. Build a Lumber Hut b: Holz geht schnell aus. Baue eine Holzfällerhütte an einem Waldfeld.
de-DE.Build a Market on a connected road. It s: Baue einen Markt an einer verbundenen Straße. Er versorgt Häuser in 3 Feldern Umkreis.
de-DE.Trade orders arrive every few days. Fulf: Alle paar Tage kommen Handelsaufträge. Erfülle einen im Auftragsbereich, sobald du die Waren hast.
Eine sehr kurze Charta. Jeder Tag zählt.
de-DE.Only 10 road tiles may exist at once. Pl: Es dürfen höchstens 10 Straßenfelder gleichzeitig existieren. Plane das Netz sorgfältig.
de-DE.Rock-strewn land leaves little room to b: Felsiges Land lässt wenig Platz zum Bauen.
de-DE.One shared map for everyone today. Same: Heute eine gemeinsame Karte für alle. Gleicher Seed, gleiche Regeln.
de-DE.Unranked. Undo allowed. Experiment freel: Ungewertet. Rückgängig erlaubt. Probier frei aus.
de-DE.The heart of the settlement. Roads must: Das Herz der Siedlung. Straßen müssen damit verbunden sein.
Verbindet Gebäude mit dem Dorfhaus. Führt durch Wald.
de-DE.Houses up to 4 residents. Needs road, wa: Bietet bis zu 4 Bewohnern Platz. Braucht Straße, Wasser und Nahrung. Rodet Wald.
de-DE.Produces 4 food per day, +1 beside water: Erzeugt 4 Nahrung pro Tag, +1 am Wasser.
de-DE.Produces wood each day. Must border fore: Erzeugt täglich Holz. Muss an Wald grenzen.
Versorgt Häuser in 2 Feldern Umkreis mit Wasser. Rodet Wald.
de-DE.Serves homes within 3 tiles, raising hap: Versorgt Häuser in 3 Feldern Umkreis und steigert Zufriedenheit und Steuern. Rodet Wald.
de-DE.That building is not available in this s: Dieses Gebäude gibt es in diesem Szenario nicht.
de-DE.This building cannot be placed on that t: Dieses Gebäude kann nicht auf diesem Gelände stehen.
Es kann nur ein Dorfhaus geben.
Holzfällerhütten müssen an ein Waldfeld grenzen.
de-DE.Must touch a road connected to the Villa: Muss an eine Straße mit Verbindung zum Dorfhaus grenzen.
Das Dorfhaus kann nicht abgerissen werden.
Dieser Handelsauftrag ist nicht mehr verfügbar.
Dir fehlen die Waren für diesen Auftrag.
de-DE.This scenario limits how many roads may: Dieses Szenario begrenzt, wie viele Straßen gleichzeitig existieren dürfen.
Rückgängig ist in diesem Modus nicht verfügbar.
de-DE.Volumes, mute, graphics quality, languag: Lautstärke, Stummschaltung, Grafikqualität, Sprache, größerer Text, hoher Kontrast und weniger Bewegung findest du in den StarHermit-Optionen.

fr-FR.Population {pop} in {days} days. Unranke: Population {pop} en {days} jours. Non classé, annulation possible.
fr-FR.Welcome back — your settlement is exactl: Bon retour : votre village est exactement comme vous l’avez laissé.
fr-FR.Saved game could not be loaded (version: Impossible de charger la partie enregistrée (version incompatible).
fr-FR.Nothing useful to do — wait for the next: Rien d’utile à faire : attendez le jour suivant.
fr-FR.💡 You can fulfil a trade order from the: 💡 Vous pouvez honorer une commande depuis le panneau des commandes.
fr-FR.Platform leaderboard — read only. Local: Classement de la plateforme : lecture seule. Les scores locaux gardent tout votre historique.
fr-FR.No friends yet — showing your own scores: Pas encore d’amis : affichage de vos propres scores.
Un habitant a quitté un foyer malheureux.
fr-FR.Food shortage! Residents are going hungr: Pénurie de nourriture ! Les habitants ont faim.
fr-FR.The charter expired before objectives we: La charte a expiré avant que les objectifs soient atteints.
fr-FR.No open orders. New orders arrive every: Aucune commande ouverte. De nouvelles arrivent tous les quelques jours.
Sélectionnez une case ou un bâtiment.
fr-FR.Every objective complete — the settlemen: Tous les objectifs sont atteints : le village prospère.
fr-FR.The charter ran out of days before objec: La charte a manqué de jours avant que les objectifs soient atteints.
fr-FR.No scores yet — be the first!: Aucun score pour l’instant : soyez le premier !
fr-FR.Grow your settlement to meet the charter: Développez votre village pour atteindre les objectifs de la charte avant le dernier jour. Les habitants s’installent dans les foyers **heureux** et quittent les malheureux.
fr-FR.A happy home has three things: a **road*: Un foyer heureux a trois choses : une **route** reliée à la Mairie, de l’**eau** d’un Puits à 2 cases au plus et de la **nourriture** dans les réserves du village. Un Marché proche ajoute du confort et des impôts.
fr-FR.Every few days a trade order arrives: de: Tous les quelques jours, une commande arrive : livrez les marchandises demandées avant son expiration pour gagner des pièces. Les pièces financent l’expansion.
Pointeur/tactile : choisissez un outil, touchez une case. Glisser déplace la carte, la molette zoome.
fr-FR.Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, [[{con: Clavier : les flèches déplacent le curseur, [[{confirm}]] construire/examiner, [[{cancel}]] annuler ou pause, [[{undo}]] annuler l’action, [[{hint}]] indice, [[{speed}]] changer la vitesse, [[{camera}]] recentrer la caméra, [[1–7]] outils.
fr-FR.Gamepad: stick/d-pad moves the cursor, A: Manette : le stick ou la croix déplacent le curseur, A confirme, B annule, Start met en pause.
fr-FR.A cozy low-poly settlement builder spann: Un jeu de construction de village low-poly tout en douceur, entre rivière et collines.
fr-FR.Lay roads and raise houses. Connect ever: Tracez des routes et bâtissez des maisons. Reliez chaque foyer à la mairie.
fr-FR.Wells supply water within 2 tiles. Keep: Les puits fournissent l’eau dans un rayon de 2 cases. Que chaque foyer ait de l’eau.
fr-FR.Farms grow food on grass; riverside farm: Les fermes produisent de la nourriture sur l’herbe ; celles au bord de l’eau rapportent plus.
fr-FR.Lumber huts must border forest. Wood fue: Les cabanes de bûcheron doivent border la forêt. Le bois alimente l’expansion.
fr-FR.Markets serve homes within 3 tiles and f: Les marchés desservent les foyers à 3 cases et honorent les commandes.
Prouvez votre maîtrise avec des limites plus strictes.
fr-FR.Select the Road tool, then build a road: Choisissez l’outil Route, puis construisez une route à côté de la Mairie.
Construisez une route de plus vers l’extérieur.
fr-FR.Select the House tool and build a house: Choisissez l’outil Maison et construisez une maison à côté d’une route reliée.
fr-FR.Build a second house. Residents move in: Construisez une deuxième maison. Les habitants emménagent quand les foyers sont heureux.
fr-FR.Reach 4 residents before the charter exp: Atteignez 4 habitants avant l’expiration de la charte. Le temps passe tout seul : mettez en pause pour réfléchir.
fr-FR.Homes need water. Build two houses near: Les foyers ont besoin d’eau. Construisez d’abord deux maisons près de la mairie.
fr-FR.Build a Well within 2 tiles of your hous: Construisez un Puits à 2 cases au plus de vos maisons.
fr-FR.Grow to 6 residents. Watch each home’s n: Atteignez 6 habitants. Surveillez les icônes de besoins de chaque foyer.
fr-FR.Hungry residents leave. Build a Farm on: Les habitants affamés partent. Construisez une Ferme sur l’herbe : au bord de l’eau, elle donne +1 nourriture.
Construisez un Puits qui couvre vos foyers.
fr-FR.Reach 8 residents without a food shortag: Atteignez 8 habitants sans pénurie de nourriture.
fr-FR.Wood runs out fast. Build a Lumber Hut b: Le bois s’épuise vite. Construisez une Cabane de bûcheron au bord d’une case de forêt.
fr-FR.Build a Market on a connected road. It s: Construisez un Marché sur une route reliée. Il dessert les foyers à 3 cases.
fr-FR.Trade orders arrive every few days. Fulf: Des commandes arrivent tous les quelques jours. Honorez-en une depuis le panneau des commandes quand vous avez les marchandises.
Une charte très courte. Chaque jour compte.
fr-FR.Only 10 road tiles may exist at once. Pl: Seules 10 cases de route peuvent exister à la fois. Planifiez soigneusement le réseau.
Le commerce avant tout : honorez 4 commandes.
fr-FR.Rock-strewn land leaves little room to b: Une terre jonchée de rochers laisse peu de place pour bâtir.
fr-FR.One shared map for everyone today. Same: Une carte commune pour tous aujourd’hui. Même graine, mêmes règles.
fr-FR.Unranked. Undo allowed. Experiment freel: Non classé. Annulation permise. Expérimentez librement.
fr-FR.The heart of the settlement. Roads must: Le cœur du village. Les routes doivent y être reliées.
Relie les bâtiments à la mairie. Traverse la forêt.
fr-FR.Houses up to 4 residents. Needs road, wa: Loge jusqu’à 4 habitants. Nécessite route, eau et nourriture. Défriche la forêt.
fr-FR.Produces 4 food per day, +1 beside water: Produit 4 nourriture par jour, +1 près de l’eau.
fr-FR.Produces wood each day. Must border fore: Produit du bois chaque jour. Doit border la forêt.
Fournit l’eau aux maisons à 2 cases. Défriche la forêt.
fr-FR.Serves homes within 3 tiles, raising hap: Dessert les foyers à 3 cases, augmentant bonheur et impôts. Défriche la forêt.
fr-FR.That building is not available in this s: Ce bâtiment n’est pas disponible dans ce scénario.
fr-FR.This building cannot be placed on that t: Ce bâtiment ne peut pas être placé sur ce terrain.
Il ne peut y avoir qu’une seule Mairie.
Les cabanes de bûcheron doivent border une case de forêt.
fr-FR.Must touch a road connected to the Villa: Doit toucher une route reliée à la Mairie.
La Mairie ne peut pas être démolie.
Il n’y a rien à démolir ici.
Il vous manque les marchandises demandées.
fr-FR.This scenario limits how many roads may: Ce scénario limite le nombre de routes simultanées.
L’annulation n’est pas disponible dans ce mode.
fr-FR.Progress restored from your StarHermit c: Progression restaurée depuis ta sauvegarde cloud StarHermit.
fr-FR.Volumes, mute, graphics quality, languag: Volumes, sourdine, qualité graphique, langue, texte agrandi, contraste élevé et mouvements réduits se trouvent dans les Options StarHermit.

pt-BR.Population {pop} in {days} days. Unranke: População {pop} em {days} dias. Sem ranking, pode desfazer.
pt-BR.Welcome back — your settlement is exactl: Bem-vindo de volta: seu vilarejo está exatamente como você deixou.
pt-BR.Saved game could not be loaded (version: Não foi possível carregar o jogo salvo (versão incompatível).
pt-BR.Nothing useful to do — wait for the next: Nada útil a fazer: espere o próximo dia.
pt-BR.💡 You can fulfil a trade order from the: 💡 Você pode atender um pedido comercial pelo painel de pedidos.
pt-BR.Platform leaderboard — read only. Local: Ranking da plataforma: somente leitura. As pontuações locais guardam todo o seu histórico.
pt-BR.No friends yet — showing your own scores: Ainda sem amigos: mostrando suas próprias pontuações.
Um morador deixou um lar infeliz.
pt-BR.New trade order: {n} {res} for {reward}: Novo pedido comercial: {n} de {res} por {reward} moedas.
pt-BR.Day {day}: +{food} food, +{wood} wood, +: Dia {day}: +{food} de comida, +{wood} de madeira, +{coins} moedas de impostos.
pt-BR.Food shortage! Residents are going hungr: Falta comida! Os moradores estão passando fome.
pt-BR.The charter expired before objectives we: A carta expirou antes de os objetivos serem cumpridos.
pt-BR.No open orders. New orders arrive every: Nenhum pedido aberto. Novos pedidos chegam a cada poucos dias.
Selecione uma casa ou um edifício.
pt-BR.Every objective complete — the settlemen: Todos os objetivos cumpridos: o vilarejo prospera.
pt-BR.The charter ran out of days before objec: Os dias da carta acabaram antes de os objetivos serem cumpridos.
pt-BR.No scores yet — be the first!: Ainda não há pontuações: seja o primeiro!
pt-BR.Grow your settlement to meet the charter: Faça seu vilarejo crescer para cumprir os objetivos da carta antes do último dia. Os moradores se mudam para lares **felizes** e deixam os infelizes.
pt-BR.A happy home has three things: a **road*: Um lar feliz tem três coisas: uma **estrada** ligada à Prefeitura, **água** de um Poço a até 2 casas e **comida** no estoque da vila. Uma Feira por perto traz conforto e impostos.
pt-BR.Every few days a trade order arrives: de: A cada poucos dias chega um pedido comercial: entregue as mercadorias pedidas antes que expire para ganhar moedas. As moedas financiam a expansão.
Ponteiro/toque: escolha uma ferramenta e toque numa casa. Arrastar move o mapa, rolar dá zoom.
pt-BR.Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, [[{con: Teclado: as setas movem o cursor, [[{confirm}]] construir/inspecionar, [[{cancel}]] cancelar ou pausar, [[{undo}]] desfazer, [[{hint}]] dica, [[{speed}]] mudar a velocidade, [[{camera}]] redefinir a câmera, [[1–7]] ferramentas.
pt-BR.Gamepad: stick/d-pad moves the cursor, A: Controle: o analógico ou direcional move o cursor, A confirma, B cancela, Start pausa.
pt-BR.A cozy low-poly settlement builder spann: Um aconchegante construtor de vilarejos low-poly entre rios e colinas.
pt-BR.Lay roads and raise houses. Connect ever: Abra estradas e erga casas. Ligue cada lar à prefeitura.
pt-BR.Wells supply water within 2 tiles. Keep: Poços fornecem água num raio de 2 casas. Mantenha todos os lares abastecidos.
pt-BR.Farms grow food on grass; riverside farm: Fazendas produzem comida na grama; as da beira do rio rendem mais.
pt-BR.Lumber huts must border forest. Wood fue: Cabanas de lenhador precisam ficar junto à floresta. A madeira impulsiona a expansão.
pt-BR.Markets serve homes within 3 tiles and f: Feiras atendem lares a até 3 casas e cumprem pedidos comerciais.
Prove sua maestria com limites mais rígidos.
pt-BR.Select the Road tool, then build a road: Escolha a ferramenta Estrada e construa uma estrada ao lado da Prefeitura.
Construa mais uma estrada saindo para fora.
pt-BR.Select the House tool and build a house: Escolha a ferramenta Casa e construa uma casa ao lado de uma estrada ligada.
pt-BR.Build a second house. Residents move in: Construa uma segunda casa. Os moradores se mudam quando os lares estão felizes.
pt-BR.Reach 4 residents before the charter exp: Chegue a 4 moradores antes que a carta expire. O tempo passa sozinho: pause se precisar pensar.
pt-BR.Homes need water. Build two houses near: Os lares precisam de água. Primeiro construa duas casas perto da prefeitura.
pt-BR.Build a Well within 2 tiles of your hous: Construa um Poço a até 2 casas das suas casas.
pt-BR.Grow to 6 residents. Watch each home’s n: Chegue a 6 moradores. Observe os ícones de necessidades de cada lar.
pt-BR.Hungry residents leave. Build a Farm on: Moradores com fome vão embora. Construa uma Fazenda na grama: na beira do rio ela rende +1 de comida.
Construa um Poço que cubra seus lares.
pt-BR.Reach 8 residents without a food shortag: Chegue a 8 moradores sem falta de comida.
pt-BR.Wood runs out fast. Build a Lumber Hut b: A madeira acaba rápido. Construa uma Cabana de lenhador junto a uma casa de floresta.
Mantenha o crescimento: chegue a 8 moradores.
pt-BR.Build a Market on a connected road. It s: Construa uma Feira numa estrada ligada. Ela atende lares a até 3 casas.
pt-BR.Trade orders arrive every few days. Fulf: Pedidos comerciais chegam a cada poucos dias. Atenda um pelo painel de pedidos quando tiver as mercadorias.
Uma carta bem curta. Cada dia conta.
pt-BR.Only 10 road tiles may exist at once. Pl: Só podem existir 10 casas de estrada ao mesmo tempo. Planeje bem a rede.
O comércio é tudo: atenda 4 pedidos.
pt-BR.Rock-strewn land leaves little room to b: O terreno cheio de pedras deixa pouco espaço para construir.
pt-BR.One shared map for everyone today. Same: Um mapa compartilhado para todos hoje. Mesma semente, mesmas regras.
pt-BR.Unranked. Undo allowed. Experiment freel: Sem ranking. Pode desfazer. Experimente à vontade.
pt-BR.The heart of the settlement. Roads must: O coração do vilarejo. As estradas precisam se ligar a ela.
Liga os edifícios à prefeitura. Atravessa a floresta.

it-IT.Food shortage! Residents are going hungr: Carenza di cibo! Gli abitanti soffrono la fame.
it-IT.The charter expired before objectives we: Lo statuto è scaduto prima di raggiungere gli obiettivi.
it-IT.No open orders. New orders arrive every: Nessun ordine aperto. Ne arrivano di nuovi ogni pochi giorni.
Seleziona una casella o un edificio.
it-IT.Every objective complete — the settlemen: Tutti gli obiettivi raggiunti: il villaggio prospera.
it-IT.The charter ran out of days before objec: Lo statuto ha esaurito i giorni prima di raggiungere gli obiettivi.
it-IT.No scores yet — be the first!: Ancora nessun punteggio: sii il primo!
it-IT.Grow your settlement to meet the charter: Fai crescere il villaggio per raggiungere gli obiettivi dello statuto prima dell’ultimo giorno. Gli abitanti si trasferiscono nelle case **felici** e lasciano quelle infelici.
it-IT.A happy home has three things: a **road*: Una casa felice ha tre cose: una **strada** collegata al Municipio, **acqua** da un Pozzo entro 2 caselle e **cibo** nelle scorte del paese. Un Mercato vicino aggiunge comfort e tasse.
it-IT.Every few days a trade order arrives: de: Ogni pochi giorni arriva un ordine commerciale: consegna le merci richieste prima che scada per guadagnare monete. Le monete finanziano l’espansione.
Puntatore/tocco: scegli uno strumento e tocca una casella. Il trascinamento sposta la mappa, la rotellina fa zoom.
it-IT.Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, [[{con: Tastiera: le frecce muovono il cursore, [[{confirm}]] costruisci/ispeziona, [[{cancel}]] annulla o pausa, [[{undo}]] annulla mossa, [[{hint}]] suggerimento, [[{speed}]] cambia velocità, [[{camera}]] ripristina telecamera, [[1–7]] strumenti.
it-IT.Gamepad: stick/d-pad moves the cursor, A: Controller: levetta o croce direzionale muovono il cursore, A conferma, B annulla, Start mette in pausa.
it-IT.A cozy low-poly settlement builder spann: Un accogliente costruttore di villaggi low-poly tra fiume e colline.
it-IT.Lay roads and raise houses. Connect ever: Traccia strade e costruisci case. Collega ogni casa al municipio.
it-IT.Wells supply water within 2 tiles. Keep: I pozzi danno acqua entro 2 caselle. Non lasciare nessuna casa senz’acqua.
it-IT.Farms grow food on grass; riverside farm: Le fattorie producono cibo sull’erba; quelle lungo il fiume rendono di più.
it-IT.Lumber huts must border forest. Wood fue: Le capanne del taglialegna devono confinare con il bosco. La legna alimenta l’espansione.
it-IT.Markets serve homes within 3 tiles and f: I mercati servono le case entro 3 caselle ed evadono gli ordini commerciali.
Dimostra la tua maestria con limiti più severi.
it-IT.Select the Road tool, then build a road: Scegli lo strumento Strada, poi costruisci una strada accanto al Municipio.
it-IT.Select the House tool and build a house: Scegli lo strumento Casa e costruisci una casa accanto a una strada collegata.
it-IT.Build a second house. Residents move in: Costruisci una seconda casa. Gli abitanti arrivano quando le case sono felici.
it-IT.Reach 4 residents before the charter exp: Arriva a 4 abitanti prima che lo statuto scada. Il tempo scorre da solo: metti in pausa se devi pensare.
it-IT.Homes need water. Build two houses near: Le case hanno bisogno d’acqua. Costruisci prima due case vicino al municipio.
it-IT.Build a Well within 2 tiles of your hous: Costruisci un Pozzo entro 2 caselle dalle tue case.
it-IT.Grow to 6 residents. Watch each home’s n: Arriva a 6 abitanti. Guarda le icone dei bisogni di ogni casa.
it-IT.Hungry residents leave. Build a Farm on: Gli abitanti affamati se ne vanno. Costruisci una Fattoria sull’erba: lungo il fiume rende +1 cibo.
Costruisci un Pozzo che copra le tue case.
it-IT.Reach 8 residents without a food shortag: Arriva a 8 abitanti senza carenze di cibo.
it-IT.Wood runs out fast. Build a Lumber Hut b: La legna finisce in fretta. Costruisci una Capanna del taglialegna accanto a una casella di bosco.
Sostieni la crescita: arriva a 8 abitanti.
it-IT.Build a Market on a connected road. It s: Costruisci un Mercato su una strada collegata. Serve le case entro 3 caselle.
it-IT.Trade orders arrive every few days. Fulf: Gli ordini commerciali arrivano ogni pochi giorni. Evadine uno dal pannello degli ordini quando hai le merci.
Uno statuto brevissimo. Ogni giorno conta.
it-IT.Only 10 road tiles may exist at once. Pl: Possono esistere solo 10 caselle di strada alla volta. Pianifica bene la rete.
Il commercio è tutto: evadi 4 ordini.
it-IT.Rock-strewn land leaves little room to b: La terra piena di rocce lascia poco spazio per costruire.
it-IT.One shared map for everyone today. Same: Una mappa condivisa per tutti oggi. Stesso seed, stesse regole.
it-IT.Unranked. Undo allowed. Experiment freel: Non classificata. Annullamento consentito. Sperimenta liberamente.
